text:
maya: Heads up — one of the private VPC canaries didn't shift traffic to v2, only 10% instead of 20% for some customers. Seeing mismatch between control plane and node snapshots. Anyone seen this pattern after the air-gapped changes?

ryan: Which customers? any logs? is the controlplane acknowledging the rollout?

maya: Two customer VPCs in eu-west-1. Console shows rollout 20% (canary-config), but nodes report still on v1. suspect snapshot apply delay or failed artifact pull.

priya: We've seen artifact fetch timeouts when nodes are air-gapped and using pre-seeded blobstore. Could be the checkpoint marker didn't advance.

aj: Can we get the controlplane's rollout stream for those tenants? I'll check if the ETag/seq matched what the nodes received.

maya: Attached snippet of the controlplane response: ```GET /v1/private/tenants/abc/rollout -> { 'version': 'v2', 'seq': 1287, 'split': 20 }``` nodes responded to /status with seq 1285.

ryan: If nodes have seq < controlplane, they should fetch snapshot on reconnect. Are the nodes stuck in exponential backoff? Logs: `snapshot_fetch: retry in 5m`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary-rollout abc -> 20% at 2026-03-18T14:32Z :white_check_mark:

aj: This smells like the config propagation guard we added — it waits for all nodes to ack a min percent before moving to next bucket. But we changed window to 'best-effort' in airgap which skips forcing fetch. Maybe bug.

priya: Suggestion: add explicit 'snapshot-checkpoint' header with checksum so nodes can detect mismatch and stream-diff instead of full fetch. Also record `last-applied-seq` metric per node.

maya: Console UX idea: show per-VPC 'pending snapshots' count + per-node last-seq so support can tell who lagging. Right now console only shows rollout %.

ryan: Agree. Also propose a guard that pauses if > x% of nodes haven't advanced after y minutes, and surface that as a modal in console with a 'force resume' option that wants org-admin approval.

aj: Force resume is risky for data-plane consistency. Maybe 'force resume (unsafe)' behind an escape hatch + audit log + 2FA.

maya: :thumbsup: For immediate mitigation, I'm rolling back the canary for those two VPCs. Will we add telemetry alerts? e.g., `rollout.progress.stalled` with tags {tenant, region, canary_id}

priya: I'll add `last_applied_seq` and `snapshot_fetch_latency` to node exporter. Can we also emit `rollout.delta-unacked` gauge?

ryan: We also need to think about A/B test gateway. If traffic split is enforced at gateway but nodes haven't applied new routing rules, we can route to a model that's not available. Short-term: make gateway check node readiness before sending new traffic.

maya: Good patch: gateway checks node metadata `ready_seq >= rollout_seq` and routes only to ready nodes. Might reduce effective sample size but safer.

aj: I'll open a postmortem-lite if rollback doesn't clear within 30m. For now, watching logs. @ryan @priya thanks.

deploy-bot: incident-bot created: rollout-stall-1916234567 — assigned to aj, priya, ryan
